page.overview:
What is Corrin quasi-nebula?

Corrin quasi-nebula is a formation near the planet Corrin in the Sigma Draconis system, to which owes its name.

It is the result of the collision (c. 250 BG) of a huge planetoid with the substellar companion of Sigma Draconis, perhaps caused by an illicit mining and smelting operation.

It comprises dust, solid bodies, and hot gases that form debris that fills the system.

It was the place of the Battle of Corrin and was still highly agitated at that time, which caused the battle to be so long-lasting (two hours).
